name: oriental-haute-couture-makeup
image_purpose: beauty campaign and couture editorial grid

prompt.project_info: Create a 2x2 cinematic fashion editorial grid combining East Asian elegance with modern graphic red makeup.
prompt.main_subject: One adult fictional East Asian woman with original non-celebrity features, modern sculptural updo with loose textured strands, natural matte porcelain skin with realistic texture, dramatic red graphic eyeliner flowing like a calligraphy stroke, full natural brows, warm peach blush, deep matte crimson lips, minimal gold drop earrings, and a deep-red embroidered kimono with floral detailing and white inner collar.
prompt.composition_elements: Four panels with the same identity, outfit, makeup, and lighting: serious calm rightward gaze; direct confident gaze; side profile emphasizing eyeliner curve; soft downward gaze. Muted dark-green gradient background, thin black grid borders, no outer border.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft diffused key from front-left with gentle cheekbone shaping, no harsh flash, subtle analog grain, warm cinematic grade, elegant artistic mood.
prompt.technical_specs: 4:5 portrait 2x2 grid, 85mm portrait-lens look, crisp skin and fabric detail, natural dynamic range, consistent identity and exposure, no text or logos.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Cinematic 2x2 fashion editorial grid of one adult fictional East Asian woman with original non-celebrity features, modern sculptural updo with loose textured strands, natural matte porcelain skin with realistic texture, dramatic red graphic eyeliner flowing like a calligraphy stroke, full natural brows, warm peach blush, deep matte crimson lips, minimal gold drop earrings, and a deep-red embroidered kimono with floral detailing and white inner collar. Same identity, outfit, makeup, and lighting in all four panels: calm rightward gaze, direct confident gaze, side profile emphasizing eyeliner curve, and soft downward gaze. Muted dark-green gradient background, thin black grid borders, soft front-left diffused key, gentle cheekbone shadows, 85mm portrait look, subtle analog grain, elegant powerful artistic couture.

assets.name: oriental-haute-couture-makeup.jpg
assets.usage: Reference the adult model, red kimono, graphic eyeliner, updo, dark-green background, four poses, and cinematic light.

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: Attach the required reference image. Preserve identity consistency, kimono, makeup, hairstyle, panel order, background, lighting, and grid. Keep accessories generic and typography absent or replaceable.
